find_locations.description: Turn a Dutch address, street, postcode, town or municipality written in full into its official details and coordinates: postcode, house number, town, municipality, province, neighbourhood, BAG IDs, latitude and longitude. Narrow it to some kinds of location, a municipality or a province, or rank results near a point.
find_locations.name: find_locations

parameters.description: What to look for, written in full, such as 'Damrak 1 Amsterdam' or 'Utrecht'. Postcodes work with or without the space. Best matches come first, but anything matching one of the words counts towards the total; put 'and' between words that must all match ('Damrak and 1 and Amsterdam'). For half-typed words use 'Suggest locations'.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Only these kinds of location. Leave empty for municipalities, towns, streets, postcodes and addresses (PDOK's own choice); tick Cadastral parcel, District, Neighbourhood and the rest to search those too.
parameters.name: types

parameters.description: Only locations in this municipality: pick one, or type its name or four-digit code (such as 0363). Leave empty for the whole country.
parameters.name: municipality

parameters.description: Only locations in this province. Leave empty for all twelve.
parameters.name: province

parameters.description: Rank locations nearer this point higher: its latitude, such as 52.0907. Give a longitude with it.
parameters.name: near_latitude

parameters.description: The point's longitude, such as 5.1214. Give a latitude with it.
parameters.name: near_longitude

parameters.description: How many locations to return, up to 100.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Which page of results to return, from 1. PDOK pages through the first 10,000 matches only.
parameters.name: page

count.description: How many are in this answer.

locations.description: The locations found, best match first.

address_type.description: For an address: 'main' for a building's main address, or 'secondary' for one of its other addresses.

apartment_number.description: For an apartment right: its number within the parcel.

bag_address_id.description: The address's BAG ID (nummeraanduiding), 16 digits, such as 0363200012113669.

bag_object_id.description: The BAG ID of what the address belongs to (a unit, mooring or pitch), 16 digits. 'Get building details' reads it.

bag_street_id.description: The street's BAG ID (openbare ruimte), 16 digits.

cadastral_designation.description: For a parcel or apartment right: its designation, such as 'Amsterdam F 6346'.

cadastral_municipality.description: For a parcel: the cadastral municipality, such as Amsterdam.

cadastral_municipality_code.description: For a parcel: the cadastral municipality's code, such as ASD04.

cadastral_section.description: For a parcel: its section, such as F.

distance_m.description: For 'Find what is at a point': its distance from the point in metres. Empty otherwise.

district.description: The CBS district (wijk) the address is in.

district_code.description: The CBS district's code, such as WK0363AD.

hectometre.description: For a hectometre marker: its position in kilometres as the post shows it, such as 100.1.

house_letter.description: The house letter, such as A in 10A.

house_number_addition.description: The house number addition, such as BS in 10A-BS or 2 in 28-2.

house_number_full.description: The house number with its letter and addition, such as 10A-BS.

id.description: PDOK's ID for the location, such as adr-8f4d573be765b4c80dd635ba73747903. 'Get a location' reads it again.

latitude.description: Its latitude (WGS84). For an area, its centre.

longitude.description: Its longitude (WGS84). For an area, its centre.

map_url.description: A link that opens it on OpenStreetMap.

municipality_code.description: The municipality's four-digit code, such as 0363. CBS writes it GM0363.

name.description: Its full name, such as 'Damrak 1, 1012LG Amsterdam'.

neighbourhood.description: The CBS neighbourhood (buurt) the address is in.

neighbourhood_code.description: The CBS neighbourhood's code, such as BU0363AD03. 'Get area statistics' reads its figures.

parcel_area_m2.description: For a parcel: its area in square metres, as the land register records it.

parcel_id.description: For a parcel or apartment right: its cadastral ID, such as ASD04-F-6346.

parcel_number.description: For a parcel: its number, such as 6346.

parcels.description: For an address: the cadastral parcels its building stands on, such as ASD04-F-6346.

province_abbreviation.description: The province's abbreviation, such as NH.

province_code.description: The province's code, such as PV27.

rd_x.description: Its x in the Dutch RD grid (EPSG:28992), in metres.

rd_y.description: Its y in the Dutch RD grid (EPSG:28992), in metres.

road_number.description: For a hectometre marker: the road, such as A2.

score.description: How well it matches the search text; higher is better. Empty for a point search.

source.description: The register it comes from: BAG (addresses and buildings), NWB (roads), DKK (cadastral map), CBS or Bestuurlijke Grenzen (boundaries).

town_code.description: The BAG code of the town, such as 3594.

more_available.description: Whether a further page has more results.

description: Look up any Dutch address, place or parcel in PDOK, the Dutch government's open map data from Kadaster. Find and autocomplete addresses, streets, towns and municipalities, turn a postcode and house number into a full address, find the addresses nearest a point, get a building's construction year, floor area and use, and get CBS figures such as population, households and average home value for any neighbourhood. No account or API key required.
